Meta-analysis physiological costs of hibernation: Report 2 - IM Hibernation

Pablo Capilla-Lasheras

2026-05-04

This R Markdown Notebook contains the initial meta-analysis for the project ‘physiological ’costs’ of hibernation. Specifically, the meta-analysis of hibernation.

Dataset and calculation of effect sizes

The dataset for this meta-analysis has been collected from the literature and curated by Pablo Burraco, Marko Prokic and Tamara Petrovic. It contains data on physiological effects of hibernation in different systems. Here a quick snapshot of the first lines of the dataset:

# dataset with raw data
data <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(
  here(
    "./01_data/raw_data/Burraco_et_al_hibernation_hibernation.xlsx"
  ),
  colNames = T,
  sheet = 2
)

paged_table(data, options = list(rows.print = 20))

As a summary of the initial dataset:

  • Number of studies: 20
  • Number of species: 12

For this initial meta-analysis, I am going to include all immune (IM) markers and calculate the standarised mean difference (g; with heteroscedastic population variances) as the effect size of analysis comparing hibernation versus euthermia. Positive SMD values indicate higher IM values in hibernation while negative SMD indicate lower IM values in hibernation. This is a summary of the effect size calculation based on the dataset above:

# ES data
data <- readRDS(
  here(
    "./01_data/processed_RDS_data_files/02_IM_metaanalysis_hibernation_full_data.RDS"
  )
)
data$obsID <- 1:nrow(data) # observation ID

# handling species names for phylogenetic-controlled models
data$Species <- replace_values(
  data$Species,
  "Lithobates pipiens" ~ "Rana pipiens"
)

data$scientific_name <- gsub(
  x = data$Species,
  pattern = "_",
  replacement = " "
)

data$scientific_name_phylo <- data$scientific_name

## data for SMD
df_SMD <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(SMDH)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SMDH.sv))

# matrix with phylogentic correlations
phylo_cor <- readRDS(
  here(
    "./01_data/processed_RDS_data_files/02_IM_phylogenetic_correlations_hibernation.RDS"
  )
)

phylo_tree <- readRDS(
  here(
    "./01_data/processed_RDS_data_files/02_IM_phylogenetic_tree_hibernation.RDS"
  )
)

tree <- ggtree(phylo_tree, size = 1.2) +
  xlim_tree(c(0, 35)) +
  geom_tiplab(
    aes(
      label = paste0(
        "italic('",
        sub(x = label, pattern = "_", replacement = " "),
        "')"
      )
    ),
    parse = TRUE,
    offset = 0.5,
    size = 5,
    hjust = 0
  )

ggsave(
  filename = here(
    "./03_plots/01_hibernation/00b_IM_phylo_tree.png"
  ),
  plot = tree,
  device = "png",
  height = 150,
  width = 90,
  units = "mm"
)

ggsave(
  filename = here(
    "./03_plots/01_hibernation/00b_IM_phylo_tree.pdf"
  ),
  plot = tree,
  height = 150,
  width = 90,
  units = "mm"
)

Summary of SMD effect size and number of observations included in the meta-analysis:

summary(df_SMD$SMDH)
##     Min.  1st Qu.   Median     Mean  3rd Qu.     Max. 
## -9.40248 -0.96256  0.07434 -0.21881  0.89528  9.37814
print(tree)

  • Number of observation with non-missing SMD: 218
  • Number of studies in the dataset for analysis: 17
  • Number of species in the dataset for analysis: 10

Initial meta-analysis:

This initial model contains only the intercept and four random effects to account for phylogenetic variation and variation between and within studies beyond sampling variance.

## calculate var-cover matrix to control for correlated effect sizes within study and tissue
V <- vcalc(
  vi = SMDH.sv,
  cluster = StudyID,
  subgroup = Tissue,
  grp1 = Hib_M,
  grp2 = Euthermia_M,
  w1 = Hib_N,
  w2 = Euthermia_N,
  data = df_SMD
)

# model
model_SMD <- rma.mv(
  yi = SMDH,
  V = V,
  mods = ~1,
  random = list(
    ~ 1 | scientific_name_phylo,
    ~ 1 | Species,
    ~ 1 | obsID,
    ~ 1 | StudyID
  ),
  data = df_SMD,
  R = list(scientific_name_phylo = phylo_cor),
  method = "REML",
  control = list(optimizer = "BFGS"),
  verbose = F
)
saveRDS(
  object = model_SMD,
  file = here(
    './04_models/01_hibernation/01b_metamodel_hibernation_IM.RDS'
  )
)
model_SMD <- readRDS(
  file = here(
    './04_models/01_hibernation/01b_metamodel_hibernation_IM.RDS'
  )
)
summary(model_SMD)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 212; method: REML)
## 
##    logLik   Deviance        AIC        BIC       AICc   
## -379.9761   759.9523   769.9523   786.7116   770.2449   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed                 factor    R 
## sigma^2.1  1.5506  1.2452      9     no  scientific_name_phylo  yes 
## sigma^2.2  0.0000  0.0038      9     no                Species   no 
## sigma^2.3  0.6646  0.8152    212     no                  obsID   no 
## sigma^2.4  0.9236  0.9610     16     no                StudyID   no 
## 
## Test for Heterogeneity:
## Q(df = 211) = 741.1496, p-val < .0001
## 
## Model Results:
## 
## estimate      se     zval    pval    ci.lb   ci.ub    
##  -1.1146  0.7685  -1.4503  0.1470  -2.6208  0.3917    
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
i2_SMD <- round(i2_ml(model_SMD), digits = 4) # heterogeneity random effects

Proportion of variation left after accounting for sampling variance and proportion accounted by each random effect:

knitr::kable(
  x = data.frame(
    Variable = names(i2_SMD),
    i2_value_percentage = as.numeric(round(i2_SMD, digits = 3))
  )
) %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = F)

Plot of results of intercept-only model:

Publication bias: small-study effects

df_SMD$inv_eff_ss <- (1 / df_SMD$Hib_N) + (1 / df_SMD$Euthermia_N)


model_SMD_pb <- rma.mv(
  yi = SMDH,
  V = V,
  mods = ~ 1 + sqrt(inv_eff_ss),
  random = list(
    ~ 1 | scientific_name_phylo,
    ~ 1 | Species,
    ~ 1 | obsID,
    ~ 1 | StudyID
  ),
  data = df_SMD,
  R = list(scientific_name_phylo = phylo_cor),
  method = "REML",
  control = list(optimizer = "BFGS"),
  verbose = F
)
saveRDS(
  object = model_SMD_pb,
  file = here(
    './04_models/01_hibernation/06b_pb_metamodel_hibernation_IM.RDS'
  )
)
model_SMD_pb <- readRDS(
  file = here(
    './04_models/01_hibernation/06b_pb_metamodel_hibernation_IM.RDS'
  )
)

summary(model_SMD_pb)

Publication bias: time-lag effects

df_SMD$year_scl <- scale(df_SMD$Year)

model_SMD_tl <- rma.mv(
  yi = SMDH,
  V = V,
  mods = ~ 1 + year_scl,
  random = list(
    ~ 1 | scientific_name_phylo,
    ~ 1 | Species,
    ~ 1 | obsID,
    ~ 1 | StudyID
  ),
  data = df_SMD,
  R = list(scientific_name_phylo = phylo_cor),
  method = "REML",
  control = list(optimizer = "BFGS"),
  verbose = F
)
saveRDS(
  object = model_SMD_tl,
  file = here(
    './04_models/01_hibernation/07b_timelag_metamodel_hibernation_IM.RDS'
  )
)
model_SMD_tl <- readRDS(
  file = here(
    './04_models/01_hibernation/07b_timelag_metamodel_hibernation_IM.RDS'
  )
)

summary(model_SMD_tl)

Plot of results of biomarker meta-regression:

biomarker_plot <- orchard_plot(

) +

    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, angle = 0),

    limits = c(-10, 10),

Endotherms vs. ectotherms:

Now, we investigate if the response to hibernation varies across biomarkers of oxidative stress for endotherms and ectotherms. We include four markers:

table(df_SMD$Biomarker_cat_2)
## < table of extent 0 >

Meta-model for endotherms:

## data for SMD
df_SMD_endo <- df_SMD %>%
  filter(!is.na(SMDH)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SMDH.sv)) %>%
  filter(Thermoregulation == 'Endothermic')

## calculate var-cover matrix to control for correlated effect sizes within study and tissue
V_endo <- vcalc(
  vi = SMDH.sv,
  cluster = StudyID,
  subgroup = Tissue,
  grp1 = Hib_M,
  grp2 = Euthermia_M,
  w1 = Hib_N,
  w2 = Euthermia_N,
  data = df_SMD_endo
)
  • Number of observation with non-missing SMD: 186
  • Number of studies in the dataset for analysis: 13
  • Number of species in the dataset for analysis: 7
model_SMD_endo <- rma.mv(
  yi = SMDH,
  V = V_endo,
  mods = ~ Biomarker_category - 1,
  random = list(
    ~ 1 | scientific_name_phylo,
    ~ 1 | Species,
    ~ 1 | obsID,
    ~ 1 | StudyID
  ),
  data = df_SMD_endo,
  R = list(scientific_name_phylo = phylo_cor),
  method = "REML",
  control = list(optimizer = "BFGS"),
  verbose = F
)
saveRDS(
  object = model_SMD_endo,
  file = here(
    './04_models/01_hibernation/04b_metareg_hibernation_endo_IM.RDS'
  )
)
model_SMD_endo <- readRDS(
  file = here(
    './04_models/01_hibernation/04b_metareg_hibernation_endo_IM.RDS'
  )
)

  width = 185,
  units = "mm"
)

Meta-model for ectotherms:

## data for SMD
df_SMD_ecto <- df_SMD %>%
  filter(!is.na(SMDH)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SMDH.sv)) %>%
  filter(Thermoregulation == 'Ectothermic')

## calculate var-cover matrix to control for correlated effect sizes within study and tissue
V_ecto <- vcalc(
  vi = SMDH.sv,
  cluster = StudyID,
  subgroup = Tissue,
  grp1 = Hib_M,
  grp2 = Euthermia_M,
  w1 = Hib_N,
  w2 = Euthermia_N,
  data = df_SMD_ecto
)
  • Number of observation with non-missing SMD: 32
  • Number of studies in the dataset for analysis: 4
  • Number of species in the dataset for analysis: 3
model_SMD_ecto <- rma.mv(
  yi = SMDH,
  V = V_ecto,
  mods = ~ Biomarker_category - 1,
  random = list(
    ~ 1 | StudyID,
    ~ 1 | scientific_name_phylo,
    ~ 1 | Species,
    ~ 1 | obsID
  ),
  data = df_SMD_ecto,
  R = list(scientific_name_phylo = phylo_cor),
  method = "REML"
)
saveRDS(
  object = model_SMD_ecto,
  file = here(
    './04_models/01_hibernation/05b_metareg_ecto_hibernation_IM.RDS'
  )
)
model_SMD_ecto <- readRDS(
  file = here(
    './04_models/01_hibernation/05b_metareg_ecto_hibernation_IM.RDS'
  )
)
summary(model_SMD_ecto)
## 
## Multivariate Meta-Analysis Model (k = 32; method: REML)
## 
##   logLik  Deviance       AIC       BIC      AICc   
## -58.6493  117.2985  129.2985  137.7057  132.9507   
## 
## Variance Components:
## 
##             estim    sqrt  nlvls  fixed                 factor    R 
## sigma^2.1  2.2986  1.5161      4     no                StudyID   no 
## sigma^2.2  2.9808  1.7265      3     no  scientific_name_phylo  yes 
## sigma^2.3  0.0000  0.0002      3     no                Species   no 
## sigma^2.4  0.7513  0.8668     32     no                  obsID   no 
## 
## Test for Residual Heterogeneity:
## QE(df = 30) = 145.4620, p-val < .0001
## 
## Test of Moderators (coefficients 1:2):
## QM(df = 2) = 2.5651, p-val = 0.2773
## 
## Model Results:
## 
##                           estimate      se     zval    pval    ci.lb   ci.ub    
## Biomarker_categoryBoth     -2.4572  1.5635  -1.5716  0.1160  -5.5216  0.6071    
## Biomarker_categoryInnate   -2.0128  1.4986  -1.3431  0.1792  -4.9501  0.9244    
## 
## ---
## Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
ecto_plot <- orchard_plot(
  object = model_SMD_ecto,
  mod = 'Biomarker_category',
  group = 'StudyID',
  trunk.size = 0.75,
  alpha = 0.2,
  cb = FALSE,
  xlab = "Standardised Mean Difference",
  transfm = "none"
) +
  scale_fill_okabe_ito() +
  scale_color_okabe_ito() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, angle = 0),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-10, 10),
    breaks = seq(-10, 10, 5),
    label = seq(-10, 10, 5)
  )
